parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Port (or the first port of a range of ports) which needs to be opened when the Trigger conditions are met.

parameters.name: PortEndRange
parameters.description: Indicates the last port of the port range that starts with {{param|Port}} which needs to be opened when the Trigger conditions are met. A value of zero (0) indicates that no port range is specified, i.e. that the range consists only of {{param|Port}}. If {{param|Port}} is zero, the value of this parameter MUST be ignored. If specified, the value of this parameter MUST be greater than or equal to the value of {{param|Port}}.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the to be forwarded port.
